high_level_description: This image captures a scene at the entrance of Meta's headquarters, specifically at the "Hacker Way" sign. The setting appears to be outdoors, with trees and greenery visible in the background, suggesting a suburban or campus-like environment. The main focus is on a large signboard that prominently displays the Meta logo, which consists of a blue infinity symbol (∞) on a white background. Below the logo, the word "Meta" is written in white text on a black background. A person is standing in front of the sign, seemingly posing for a photo.
